# Workplan template

**Purpose:** Copy the **template block** below when starting a new initiative on this repo. Replace all `[PLACEHOLDER]` values. Keep sections **short**; every checkbox should be a **single, verifiable action**. Use **Iteration N** to group work by dependency order (spec → build → integrate → ship), not by calendar week.

**Do not edit this file for real work.** Save a copy as `docs/workplans/<kebab-slug>.md` and link it from your PR.

**Before planning:** Read [`docs/AI-README.md`](AI-README.md) and the relevant topic guide (`blog-content.md`, `seo-geo.md`, etc.).

**Tone:** The H1 names the initiative. **Board ask** is one short paragraph (intent and hard constraints). **Done when** lists checkable acceptance outcomes. **Out of scope** blocks scope creep. **Feedback for Product team** holds decisions that need a human owner.

**Do not include:** QA plans, test suites, screenshot sign-off gates, or “validate in browser” task lists unless the stakeholder explicitly asks for them.

---

## Canonical section order

1. **`# WORKPLAN: …`** — Short title (and optional subtitle / surface).
2. **`---`**
3. **Board ask** — One paragraph under the H1.
4. **`---`**
5. **`## Done when`** — `- [ ]` / `- [x]` bullets; measurable outcomes.
6. **`---`**
7. **Body:** `## Iteration 1` … `## Iteration N` **or** `## Checklist (tick as you go)` for a single-track slice.
8. **`---`**
9. **`## Out of scope`**
10. **`---`**
11. **`## Feedback for Product team`**

**Optional:** `## Appendix` (dependencies, file map, links to contracts).

---

## How agents should use this template

- [ ] Copy to **`docs/workplans/<slug>.md`** — see [`workplans/README.md`](workplans/README.md).
- [ ] One **primary owner surface** per iteration where possible (avoid scatter).
- [ ] Prefer **file paths** and **symbol names** (`src/data/*Contract.ts`, `src/lib/…`) so work is executable without guessing.
- [ ] Keep **3–5 iterations** for most slices; split only when parallel tracks are real.
- [ ] Update the **index table** in `docs/workplans/README.md` when opening or closing an initiative.
- [ ] Run `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` before marking **Done when** complete (see AI-README **When to Review**).

---

# WORKPLAN: `[SHORT_TITLE]` ([optional subtitle / surface])

**Board ask:** [One paragraph: what you ship, for whom, and any hard constraint — pathname, contract, Figma node, flag key, or no new dependencies.]

---

## Done when

- [ ] [Measurable outcome 1 — user-visible or contract-visible.]
- [ ] [Measurable outcome 2.]
- [ ] [Measurable outcome 3 — include no regression to named adjacent behavior if relevant.]

---

## Iteration 1 — Spec / contract (lock before code)

- [ ] [Confirm behavior for edge cases with PM or design.]
- [ ] [Write or extend contract — `src/data/*Contract.ts`, `src/content.config.ts`, etc.]
- [ ] [List primary files or entry points to touch.]

---

## Iteration 2 — Core implementation

- [ ] [Implement in `path/to/file` — match existing Astro/TS conventions.]
- [ ] [Reuse `src/lib/` helpers; avoid drive-by refactors outside the ask.]

---

## Iteration 3 — Integration / wiring

- [ ] [Wire into layout, route, or `SiteBodyChrome` — name the parent file.]
- [ ] [Update topic guide or AI-README if behavior/contracts changed (same PR).]

---

## Iteration 4 — Release readiness (optional)

- [ ] [Env var, feature flag, or Vercel config — only if required.]
- [ ] [Operator note in code or `docs/deployment.md` if needed.]
- [ ] [One-line rollback note in the PR description.]

---

## Out of scope

- [Adjacent feature or surface explicitly excluded.]
- [Deferred technical choice.]
- **QA and automated tests** — omit unless the stakeholder explicitly requests them in the workplan.

---

## Feedback for Product team

- [Open question 1 — owner and deadline if known.]
- [Open question 2 — copy, legal, experiment audience, etc.]

---
